last_completed_unit.target: Cargo source replacement using a vendored directory source and the exact network/registry claim
last_completed_unit.finding: The official Cargo Source Replacement page states that source replacement redirects registry or git-source communication to another data source, including an exact local copy; it explicitly supports vendored local-filesystem sources and shows replacing crates-io with a directory source. The same page does not establish a universal no-network guarantee for every Cargo operation.
last_completed_unit.verified_scope: Cargo can replace the crates.io dependency source with a checked-in local directory source via .cargo/config.toml source replacement.
last_completed_unit.not_verified_scope: Universal no-network dependency resolution/build behavior; all Cargo commands; Chat-native Cargo execution; end-to-end richer-mode parity.

source_scope: Current required repository controls for open_source, current own LATEST, SHA-only note-main identity, and exactly one official Cargo documentation page: https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/cargo/reference/source-replacement.html.
scope_guard: Do not infer a universal offline guarantee from source replacement alone. It verifies local replacement of dependency sources, not that Cargo will never access the network for any reason.
